bug_report:
integer registers of vector constant load shouldn't go through memory
[hjl@gnu-zen4-1pr121015]$ cat x.c
typedef int __attribute__((__vector_size__ (4))) S;
extern int bar (S);

int
foo ()
{
  return bar ((S){-1});
}
[hjl@gnu-zen4-1pr121015]$ gcc -Og -fno-dce -mtune=generic -S x.c
[hjl@gnu-zen4-1pr121015]$ cat x.s
	.file	"x.c"
	.text
	.globl	foo
	.type	foo, @function
foo:
.LFB0:
	.cfi_startproc
	subq	$8, %rsp
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	movl	.LC0(%rip), %edi

We should generate "movl $-1, %edi" here.

	call	bar
	addq	$8, %rsp
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
.LFE0:
	.size	foo, .-foo
	.section	.rodata.cst4,"aM",@progbits,4
	.align 4
.LC0:
	.long	-1
	.ident	"GCC: (GNU) 15.1.1 20250521 (Red Hat 15.1.1-2)"
	.section	.note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
[hjl@gnu-zen4-1pr121015]$
